highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m147/m148.
highlights_body: It reworks the singleton lifecycle, promotes legacy paint/obsolete text APIs to compile errors, adds animated WebP encoding and variable/color-font support, and fixes pixel-access and disposal bugs. This is a breaking release — check the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: Legacy paint text/font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint members obsoleted in the v3 line (text size, typeface, and related text-reading APIs) are promoted from warnings to compiler errors. Move text and font state onto SKFont instead.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs and enums promoted to error and trimmed
breaking.body: The remaining pre-v4 obsolete surface is promoted to a compile error, and obsolete enum members are removed from the reference assembly. Update call sites flagged by the compiler to their v4 replacements before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped and loses value-equality
breaking.body: The property changes from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which no longer implements IEquatable<T> or the equality operators. Code comparing these values must switch to member-by-member comparison.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its public setter
breaking.body: The property is now get-only; code that assigned it directly must remove the assignment.

breaking.title: new SKFont() and new SKPaint().Typeface no longer resolve lazily to null
breaking.body: A default-constructed SKFont now has an empty (not null) typeface, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set one explicitly; new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null. Replace `== null` checks with `Typeface.IsEmpty`, and construct SKFont with an explicit typeface when you need text to measure/draw immediately.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are never null
breaking.body: FromFamilyName("missing") now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (previously null on Android), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict "was it found" check use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload previously truncated out-of-range offsets silently; it now throws OverflowException for out-of-range values and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 context instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a 1.0 instance/device causes a fatal, uncatchable process abort rather than a null return. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0).

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative drops five legacy interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; there is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice since Skia no longer manages that ownership.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed
breaking.body: A new Components field (and GRVkYcbcrComponents struct) was added, changing the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or depends on this struct's layout must account for the new field.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances through m147/m148, including several upstream chrome bug-fix syncs, bringing the current upstream renderer to the v4 line.
Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and improves color font palette handling and variable font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream reads
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.

bullets.lead: New sampling and HarfBuzz color APIs
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads, and a new HBColor struct exposes hb_color_t; several missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes were also added.
SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the offset, fixing incorrect pixel reads.

Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers.
Fixes SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI TabBar, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer.
Reworks the lifecycle of singleton instances and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor, improving startup reliability.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 native builds for Tizen, and PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs.
Updates expat, freetype, libpng, libexpat, libjpeg-turbo, and zlib to their latest versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, legacy paint/text obsolete promotions, variable and color font support, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The 4.148.0 release candidate finalized the v4 API surface ahead of the stable ship.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 continued stabilizing the v4 engine bump and added further font and pixel-access fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, variable font support, and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 engine bump and the initial v4 obsolete-API promotions.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundled HarfBuzz updates to 14.2.0, adding the HBColor struct and picking up missing API wrappers, naming-convention fixes, and variable-font shaping improvements.
